validity.recommendation: Check whether the owner should be the Belarus subsidiary. If yes, change Owner1 to Gazprom Transgaz Belarus OJSC.
validity.researcher_notes: The line lies in Belarus and Russia. The Belarus section is run and held by Gazprom Transgaz Belarus, a wholly owned Gazprom subsidiary. The sheet names only the Gazprom parent. The owner change is staged on the fill record. The length of 851 km is stated per string, so the first string is not 453 km, which is only the Belarus part of the first string.

verifications.note: The activities page of Gazprom Transgaz Belarus lists the line among its working pipelines

fills.researcher_notes: The Belarus gas transport company lists the three string Torzhok to Minsk to Ivatsevichi line among the pipelines it runs today. A 2023 Belarus energy report also lists it. Status operating stands.

verifications.note: The company history dates the first string to 1974

fills.researcher_notes: The company history says the first string of the line, 453 km long, began work in 1974. The second string followed in 1978 and the third in 1983. The sheet start year 1974 stands for the first string.

fills.researcher_notes: A table of gas transport projects lists Torzhok to Minsk to Ivatsevichi at 851 km for each of three strings. The length of 851 km is therefore the length of one string. The table is an archived copy of a page that no longer loads.

verifications.note: Page names the company as the operator of the transit pipelines including this line

fills.researcher_notes: The activities page of Gazprom Transgaz Belarus says the company runs the line. The operator on the sheet stands.

fills.researcher_notes: Gazprom PJSC is the parent. The company page says Gazprom Transgaz Belarus is a wholly owned Gazprom subsidiary. A district council document of 2021 lists the Belarus section of the line among the assets of Gazprom Transgaz Belarus. The owner of the asset is the Belarus subsidiary, so the owner is changed to Gazprom Transgaz Belarus JSC at 100 percent. No page states the ownership of the line in one sentence, so the tier is medium. Owner1 is written 'Gazprom Transgaz Belarus JSC' by the source; spelled the ownership team's way as 'Gazprom Transgaz Belarus OJSC'. per Baird's ruling of 2026-10-20.

verifications.note: The activities page of Gazprom Transgaz Belarus lists the line among its working pipelines

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The company activities page of May 2025 lists the three string line among the pipelines it runs. Status operating stands.
